representation: Reports, prompts and receipts are byte-exact. Published chain segments are losslessly gzipped. Complete external-snapshot sections and co-located source material remain local; original hashes and ranges are preserved. Per-chain retention.json states the archived and local-only segments. Raw execution payloads remain local; audit summaries are explicit bounded derivatives.
independence: Independent initials share the frozen source packet. Confirmations use the original reviewer where available; the explicitly attributed Claude replacement uses the unchanged original report, actual runtime delta and explicitly selected author responses and source evidence. Intermediate confirmations retain their raw verdicts and snapshot-specific acceptance; neither accepted nor unaccepted earlier snapshots are final acceptance of this revision. The executed compacted first confirmation remains VOID, reportless and excluded from teaching evidence and acceptance.
limits: Bounded textual and host evidence, not native/device or arbitrary-pool acceptance.
